runtime_prompt_en:
Create a photographic architectural fashion editorial in a Nasrid-inspired palace courtyard. An adult woman works as a botanical illustrator, holding an open sketchbook beside the water. Use the attached portrait as an appearance reference for her long dark wavy hair, softly oval face, brown eyes, and natural rose lips. She wears a dark teal long-sleeved silk dress and sits sideways on a low stone bench, her face turned three quarters toward the camera, the open sketchbook resting across her lap with one visible plant study and a pencil held loosely in her right hand. A narrow, shallow stone-lined water channel runs from the lower foreground toward the far courtyard, its clear water catching small reflected highlights. A continuous arcade of slender columns and repeated arches encloses the courtyard behind her; the arches open onto a shaded walkway, making its depth legible. Two low planting beds flank the channel with green leaves and a few white flowers. Late afternoon sun enters from the right, warming one edge of her hair and casting repeated arch shadows across pale paving. Compose a vertical, full-body environmental portrait with the woman left of center and the channel leading the eye into the background. Keep her face, the channel edges, and the repeated column spacing clear enough to read together. The photograph feels quietly observational, with realistic stone grain, silk folds, water reflections, and restrained color. Use a 40mm lens at seated eye height with moderate depth of field, keeping the near channel rim and the far column bases legible. A soft reflection from the pale paving fills the shadow side of her face while the sunlit stone remains brighter.

Avoid: over-processed retouching, body distortion, unrealistic hands, illustration look, plastic-looking skin, fake-looking background, broken facial features, 3D render look
